meta.title: 「i人」做数据分析为什么总吃亏？三个能力短板
meta.title_en: Why Introverts Lose Out in Data Science

scenes.context: 讲者抛出 i人做 Data 的困境：不懂外化想法，技术流的 Presentation 没人听、结论没人采纳。
sentences: i人真的不适合做Data，因为i人在职场中完全不懂如何外化自己的想法。
Introverts aren't cut out for data work — they never learn to get their ideas across at work.
外化自己的想法：get your ideas across
技术背景的i人做Presentation，一不小心就会把整场项目会议变得非常枯燥。
When a tech-savvy introvert gives a presentation, the whole meeting can easily turn painfully dull.
变得非常枯燥：turn painfully dull
如果你技术很牛，合作方就会信任你的分析结论。
If your technical skills are solid, your partners will trust your analysis.
分析结论：analysis conclusions
paraphrase: Strong tech skills don't equal good storytelling.
听众在意结论，不在推导
Audiences care about the takeaway, not the process.
scenes.speak: Introverts aren't cut out for data work — they never learn to get their ideas across at work. When a tech-savvy introvert gives a presentation, the whole meeting can easily turn painfully dull. If your technical skills are solid, your partners will trust your analysis.

scenes.context: 讲者指出 i人喜欢自己硬扛、不借领导力量，主张建立反馈机制并让领导做选择题。
sentences: i人经常喜欢自己去硬扛，而不懂如何借助领导的力量。
Introverts tend to tough things out alone instead of leveraging their manager.
硬扛：tough it out
在没有和领导对齐分析思路的情况下，就靠自己不成熟的经验开展了重要项目的分析。
I kicked off a major analysis with a half-baked approach, without aligning my thinking with my manager first.
对齐思路：align on the approach
要尽量让领导做选择题，而不是开放式问答。
Give your manager clear options to choose from, not open-ended questions.
做选择题：give options
paraphrase: 自己硬扛 → 借领导的力量
From going it alone to leveraging your manager.
开放式问答 → 选择题
From open-ended questions to clear options.
scenes.speak: Introverts tend to tough things out alone instead of leveraging their manager. I kicked off a major analysis with a half-baked approach, without aligning my thinking with my manager first. Give your manager clear options to choose from, not open-ended questions.

scenes.title_cn: 短板三：缺乏主人翁意识
scenes.context: 讲者指出被动接需求是缺主人翁意识，数据分析师应站在公司全局给出专业建议。
sentences: 运营或者产品想看什么数据，i人就会尽力去满足，这其实是没有主人翁意识。
When ops or product ask for data, introverts just deliver — that's actually a lack of ownership.
主人翁意识：sense of ownership
你应该站在客观的立场，看待公司的所有经营活动。
You should look at all of the company's operations from an objective standpoint.
客观立场：objective standpoint
i人要记住，你不从属于任何一个业务同学，要给出数据视角的专业结论和建议。
Remember: you don't report to any single business owner — share your data-driven professional opinion.
不从属于：don't report to
paraphrase: 被动接需求 → 主动给建议
From passively taking requests to actively advising.
从属于业务 → 站在公司全局
From serving one team to viewing the whole company.
scenes.speak: When ops or product ask for data, introverts just deliver — that's actually a lack of ownership. You should look at all of the company's operations from an objective standpoint. Remember: you don't report to any single business owner — share your data-driven professional opinion.

practice: Learn to get your ideas across at work.
Give your manager clear options to choose from.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：i人 doesn't suit Data.
✓ 地道说法：Introverts aren't cut out for data work.
be cut out for 表示「天生适合」，比 suit 更口语。
✓ 地道说法：Get my ideas across.
对外表达想法用 get across 更自然。
✕ 直译腔：Let the leader do choice questions.
✓ 地道说法：Give my manager clear options.
让领导做选择题→给出可选项。
✕ 直译腔：I don't belong to any business classmate.
✓ 地道说法：I don't report to any single business owner.
不从属于→不对任何单一业务方负责。
shifts: 用讲故事的能力发挥影响力
主动和领导对齐并借助领导力量
把主人翁意识当专业分内事
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词按语境校正：「爱人」校正为「i人」（内向型人格）、「RNFP」校正为「INFP」、「主人工意识」校正为「主人翁意识」、「应抗」校正为「硬扛」、「批凌任务」校正为「排期任务」、「内行」校正为「内耗」；Data、Storytelling、Presentation 等术语保留英文。
